notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address may be wrong. You can go back to the list of clients.

select.title: Choose a client
select.intro: In each interview, your goal is to discover what the client needs. Some needs come up only when you ask the right questions.

interview.endHint_one: You can end the interview after asking at least {{count}} question.
interview.endHint_other: You can end the interview after asking at least {{count}} questions.

endDialog.title: End the interview?
endDialog.body: Next, you'll summarise the client's needs and recommend products.

catalog.title: Product catalogue
catalog.intro: Products you can recommend. All of them are fictional.

wrapup.title: Wrap up your interview with {{name}}
wrapup.intro: Summarise the client's needs, then recommend the products that fit them and say why.
wrapup.atMax: That's the maximum. To choose a different product, untick one first.

errors.reasonLong: The reason for {{product}} is too long.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.loading: The coach is reviewing your interview. The first review can take up to a minute.

degraded.title: The AI coach isn't available right now
degraded.body: The discovery map and the verdicts on your recommendations below are still accurate: they come from the answer key, not from the AI. You can ask the coach again.

map.title: Discovery map
map.byPitch: In reaction to a product you proposed.

recommendations.title: Your recommendations

coach.betterQuestion: A question you could have asked:

profile.englishOnly: Parts of the profile are available in English only.

errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: We can't reach the server. Check that the app is running, then try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you asked for.
errors.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: This interview is no longer available. Interviews are kept only for a limited time, and they're lost when the app restarts.
errors.UNKNOWN_CLIENT: This client is no longer available. Please choose another client.
errors.SESSION_BUSY: The client is still answering your last message. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.TURN_LIMIT: You've used all your questions. You can now end the interview.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This step isn't available at this point in the interview.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some of what you entered isn't valid. Check it, then try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: The AI model is busy. Wait a few seconds, then try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.INVALID_OUTPUT: The AI client's reply couldn't be used. Please try again.
errors.LLM_ERROR: The AI model returned an error. Please try again.
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The AI model isn't available right now. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.MODEL_TIMEOUT: The AI model took too long to reply. Please try again.
